[Disrupt Undead](/Spells.aspx?ID=79), [Electric Arc](/Spells.aspx?ID=97), [Know Direction](/Spells.aspx?ID=169), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246)

[Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Longstrider](/Spells.aspx?ID=175) (*), [Shocking Grasp](/Spells.aspx?ID=283) (*)

[Acid Arrow](/Spells.aspx?ID=2) (*), [Entangle](/Spells.aspx?ID=103) (*), [Restoration](/Spells.aspx?ID=258)

- **4th**
[Plant Growth](/Rituals.aspx?ID=18)

They roll a saving throw against the affliction with a +2 circumstance bonus. If they must attempt an ongoing save against the same poison at the end of their turn, they also get a +2 circumstance bonus to that save.
